purpose: Exact additive rows for the canonical server/gcsp/policy/seed-v1.json assumptions array (serial policy lane). Tests merge them into the real seed and read them only through PolicyService; this file is not a registry.

items.label: Vehicle agreement
items.basis: Synthetic stand-in for signing the vehicle agreement; two demo days is a plausible response window. Signing may follow booking.

items.label: Driving licence check
items.basis: Synthetic scheme-team check of the employee's licence; an hour of demo time is a plausible turnaround.

items.label: Vehicle preparation
items.basis: Synthetic retailer preparation (valet, plates, handover pack); one demo day is plausible.

items.label: Delivery to the retailer
items.basis: Synthetic transport of the car to the collecting retailer; two demo days is plausible.

assumptions.unit: document and readiness item registry; seconds of demo-clock time
assumptions.basis: Plausible synthetic document and vehicle-readiness steps after an order is sent to ordering (HLD columns 12 and 13). Not BMW policy; owners, delays and the opening stage are revisable here.

value.failureReason: The synthetic provider reported this step as failed.

assumptions.unit: item IDs selected to fail; reason text
assumptions.basis: Difficult-case switch for the synthetic provider. Empty by default; a scenario version lists the scheme-team or retailer items that fail.
Keyed exception types recorded with the renewal-case receipt shape. The renewal-risk trigger uses them only when renewalCase.lifecycle.eventTypes selects them.
